name: web_automator
description: Automates web tasks: filling forms, scraping data, monitoring pages, repetitive browser actions
instructions: 1) Determine target URL and what action is needed. 2) Use browser_control for web interaction (go_to, click, type, fill_form). 3) For data extraction, use browser_control get_text or take screenshots. 4) Save extracted data with file_controller. 5) For repeated tasks, suggest creating a background agent.
knowledge: XPATH and CSS selector basics. Form automation patterns: find input fields, fill, submit. Data extraction: text content, attributes, tables. Rate limiting: add delays between actions. Headless vs headed browsing. Cookie/session management. Pagination handling.
